stories.title: Apple says more ex-employees may have taken confidential data to OpenAI
stories.summary: Apple's trade-secrets lawsuit against OpenAI has escalated, with Apple now alleging that additional former employees may have carried confidential company material to OpenAI, according to TechCrunch and Engadget. OpenAI has pushed back hard, with Ars Technica reporting the company called the suit "aggressive and oddly personal," and Engadget noting OpenAI says Apple "is getting this wrong." The dispute underscores rising legal tension between the two companies as they compete for AI talent and technology.
stories.whyItMatters: A trade-secrets fight between two of the industry's most powerful AI players could reshape how companies police employee movement and IP in the AI talent war.
whatToWatch: Whether Apple names additional former employees or specifies the alleged trade secrets
OpenAI's formal legal response to the amended claims
Any impact on hiring practices or non-compete enforcement across the AI industry
questions: What specific confidential material does Apple allege was taken?
Could this dispute affect any existing business ties between Apple and OpenAI?

stories.title: Texas halts new data center grid connections, orders audits
stories.summary: Texas has paused new data center hookups to its power grid, with the governor calling for audits before facilities can connect, according to TechCrunch and The Verge. The move comes as AI-driven data center construction has surged, putting new strain on state power infrastructure.
stories.whyItMatters: Texas is a major hub for data center growth, and a state-ordered halt signals that grid capacity and political patience for AI infrastructure expansion may be running out.
whatToWatch: What the audit criteria will require of data center operators
How long the connection halt remains in place
Whether other states with grid-strain concerns follow Texas's lead
questions: Which specific data center projects or companies are affected?
Will the audit requirement slow announced AI infrastructure investment in the state?
